title: Jelly Jaded Turkish Apples Manti
description: A silky, umami twist on traditional Turkish manti, featuring bramley apples and score-fat. Perfect for a romantic date-night dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the ground lamb, crispy bulgur, chopped onion, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Heat the score-fat in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the lamb mixture and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned and cooked through.
Add the beef broth to the skillet and bring to a simmer. Reduce the heat to low and cook for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and core the Bramley apples. Cut them into 1-inch wedges.

To assemble the manti, place a tablespoon of the lamb mixture onto the center of each dumpling wrapper. Top with a Bramley apple wedge and a sprinkle of parsley. Fold the wrapper over the filling and press the edges together to seal.
Cook the manti in the skillet with the lamb fat for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Serve the manti hot with additional parsley and a dollop of yogurt, if desired.
